due_when.clears_when: `lane_reconcile.py --sessions <a fresh dump>` reports ZERO walled lanes and ZERO finished-but-unarchived lanes, OR each remaining one carries a stated reason for being left open. A walled lane needs a HUMAN to clear its permission prompt, so this cannot close autonomously -- which is the point of it being a row rather than a note.
